_doc: Cross-language SAFETY contract: which URLs may be rendered as an href. Three implementations must agree - bristlenose/utils/safe_url.py, frontend/src/utils/safeUrl.ts, and Swift's WebView.swift::openExternal, which guards NSWorkspace against file:// app-launches. Sibling of shared-format-contract.json, which does this for RENDERED formats; a mismatch there is a visible inconsistency, a mismatch here is a hole.
_how_to_use: Asserted by tests/test_safe_url_contract.py and frontend/src/utils/safeUrl.test.ts. Both read this file; a language that disagrees fails its own suite with the case named. Adding a case here is how you report a bypass - write the case first, watch it fail, then fix both sides.
_scope: This pins the POLICY (which schemes, and whether a host is required), not the parsing. Parsing is urlparse and new URL() respectively - the WHATWG normalisation is the hard half and is deliberately not ours.
